createStory.coverAltPlaceholder: e.g. An ornate brass pocket watch floating over a misty Victorian canal
createStory.openingHelper: Write between 2 and 5 sentences to set the scene, introduce the protagonist, and pose a compelling hook.
createStory.openingPlaceholder: The brass pendulum swung with a hollow chime, echoing across the vacant workshop. Silas gripped the silver key tightly in his trembling fingers, knowing this was the only door his master had forbidden him to unlock. Outside, the rain began to fall in earnest against the frosted skylight.
